senses.gloss: f. (φιλοτιμία, S.) display, public show, esp. gladiatorial exhibition, combats of beasts &c. (v. Sachs Beitr. I, p. 120).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>שמע שפ׳ נעשית</he> (not <cite ref="Q00971"><he>פלוטמיא</he></cite>) he heard that a show is coming up; <he>שאל … פ׳</he> he asked a gladiator (<cite ref="L00205"><he>לוּדָר</he></cite>), when will the show take place?; <he>שאל לאותו שעושה פ׳</he> he asked him who was to give the show (‘editor’).
